answer_4.quote: We ask judges to rate each conversation under the seven aforementioned measurement criteria (Figure ) along with a continuous rating scale labeled only at each extreme with strongly disagree (left); strongly agree (right).
answer_4.guideline: Rate the degree to which you agree with statements such as: Robotic: It was obvious that I was talking to a chatbot as opposed to another human user. Interesting: The conversation with the chatbot was interesting. Fun: The conversation with the chatbot was fun/enjoyable. Consistent: The chatbot was consistent throughout the conversation. Fluent: The chatbot's English was fluent and natural throughout the conversation. Repetitive: I felt that the chatbot kept being repetitive during the conversation. Topic: The chatbot stays on topic.
